kill_rules: Any probability or payload difference ends the output-neutral qualification and creates a separately versioned compression candidate.
Any full phase beyond its bound Geekbench5 runtime retires this implementation as official-record-facing.
Any process-tree or cgroup peak at or above the decimal limit fails official memory eligibility.
A post-purge trough at or above the decimal limit retires PPM purging; a failure caused only by the 5000-byte inter-check sawtooth authorizes one measured cadence successor.
A failure before Predictor construction authorizes the existing malloc_trim q0 patch as the single successor.
Any complete counted score above 109685196 fails the current-record lane.
Do not tune a threshold ladder. One failure may authorize only one phase-attributed correction whose threshold is derived before execution from the measured non-PPM footprint and a frozen reserve.
execution_order.pass_meaning: An opening-1M pass proves only output-neutral identity, exact inverse, replay, package arithmetic, and execution-envelope behavior on that population. It does not create an official-record candidate, prove memory/runtime/disk/CPU eligibility, or authorize a larger gate. A separately frozen resource successor is mandatory.
